notes: S306 recovery-aware full audit. Premises were checked against the live release feeds, focused source searches, the bounded 29,952-token sampler, recent decisions, current telemetry, and the internal-tool registry. UX is 2.5x, speed 2x, and feature depth 1.5x. Every item names a conversion or information-finding outcome. Sequence compounds release truth first, then fast verification, then engagement and discovery depth; production remains held until the external Obelisk callback is genuinely registered.

items.title: Contextual Vault bridge — turn game interest into an earned membership path
items.why: PRE-VERIFIED: games own 37 of 52 recent views while /membership has one. The site has rich rank, constellation, and adaptive-pricing systems, but a visitor arriving through a game does not receive a compact, game-specific explanation of what entering the Vault unlocks. Outcome: move high-intent game readers to the relevant membership proof without generic SaaS upsell language.
items.recipe: L2 default: add one lazy, context-derived bridge on game detail pages using registry metadata, current game title, and the existing rank/value surfaces; primary action goes to /membership/?from=<game>, secondary to /proof/. Emit bounded impression/click families and include the source game in aggregate telemetry. Reuse the ambient bundle, CTA registry, and existing adaptive-pricing vocabulary; no dependency.

L1.recipe: Static game-aware bridge on the three highest-traffic game pages with bounded telemetry.

L2.recipe: Generator-driven bridge across every game page, contextual copy, proof fallback, telemetry contract, seven-theme mobile/desktop visual proof.

L3.recipe: L2 plus local constellation/rank progress context and a returning-visitor continuation state, still anonymous and local-first.

executionLog.note: Shipped route-derived game→Vault membership/proof bridge with bounded source telemetry; 56-state visual matrix reviewed green.

items.title: Obelisk redirect-readiness contract — fail before staging deploy, not after browser ceremony
items.why: PRE-VERIFIED: canonical staging is healthy, yet Obelisk returns tenant-boundary-redirect-origin-not-registered-to-client for the exact callback. deploy-staging.mjs has no provider registration preflight. Outcome: every staging candidate proves its relying-party callback is accepted before a 4,475-file deploy, shortening sign-in recovery and preventing false release confidence.
items.recipe: Build scripts/check-obelisk-redirect-readiness.mjs around the public authorization endpoint. A valid client+exact staging redirect must reach the sign-in surface; an altered host and cross-client redirect must remain rejected. Publish a privacy-safe receipt with issuer/client/callback hashes and reason codes, wire self-test + --check into build:check and deploy-staging preflight, and keep registration itself owner-gated through Ark.

L1.recipe: Exact callback live probe with honest passed/rejected/unverified states and hermetic parser tests.

L2.recipe: L1 plus two tenant-negative controls, receipt, deploy-staging fail-fast, and build gate.

L3.recipe: L2 plus signed Ark request/ack correlation and expiry-bound evidence consumed by release-proof.

executionLog.note: Shipped exact callback probe, two negative controls, receipt, and staging fail-fast; live exact callback honestly remains rejected pending Obelisk registration.

items.title: Progressive onboarding trigger — ask after intent, not on arrival
items.why: PRE-VERIFIED: the tour was offered 36 times and started/completed once. The current trigger spends attention before the visitor has chosen a world or Vault path. Outcome: increase tour start/completion and reduce first-visit interruption by offering the smallest relevant route after a meaningful signal.
items.recipe: Move the offer behind an intent event (second page, project-detail action, command-palette query, or 50% engaged scroll), select a three-step micro-tour by current route family, and preserve reduced-motion/keyboard behavior. Add offered→started→completed per-route cohorts and a deterministic test for never offering on immediate arrival.

L1.recipe: Delay the existing tour until one meaningful engagement signal and add regression coverage.

L2.recipe: Route-family micro-tours, bounded funnel events, cooldown, accessibility, and seven-theme rendered proof.

L3.recipe: L2 plus local intent memory that resumes the most relevant unfinished tour without identity or server state.

executionLog.note: Shipped earned-intent onboarding after second page/action/command/50% scroll with local lifecycle and four route-specific tours.

items.title: Change-aware verification planner — preserve 275/275 authority, cut the inner loop
items.why: PRE-VERIFIED: the authoritative build check is 275 sequential steps and the latest clean run took 609 seconds. run-build-check supports --from but intentionally rejects partial coverage as complete; it has no changed-path planner. Outcome: developers get a trusted sub-minute impacted check after each edit while closeout still requires the full measured receipt.
items.recipe: Create a declarative command↔input map derived from the existing build step list and observed import/producer edges. scripts/plan-build-check.mjs --changed emits a deterministic subset plus reasons and a source fingerprint; scripts/run-impacted-checks.mjs records a clearly PARTIAL receipt that can never satisfy closeout. Gate map coverage against package.json so new steps fail closed until classified; use the existing build-check evidence kernel and timing diagnostics.

L1.recipe: Map the changed recovery surfaces to focused commands and emit a non-authoritative plan.

L2.recipe: General planner, coverage gate, partial receipt, timing comparison, and package scripts.

L3.recipe: L2 plus transitive producer/import graph, safe parallel batches, and historical hit-rate calibration.

executionLog.note: Shipped transitive change planner and partial runner while preserving the 275/275 authoritative closeout suite.

items.title: One-command release ceremony — explicit staging browser proof becomes unskippable
items.why: PRE-VERIFIED: tests/staging-release.spec.js skips when STAGING_RELEASE_URL is absent and no release workflow invokes it. This let 35 healthy checks visually mask the one identity failure until a manual focused run. Outcome: a release operator gets one deterministic go/no-go command whose green requires the actual canonical staging browser contract.
items.recipe: Add scripts/run-release-ceremony.mjs that requires the canonical staging URL, runs redirect readiness, staging receipt/continuity checks, chromium staging-release.spec.js, production-promotion gate, and Doctor; emit a JSON receipt with exact command statuses and no stdout bodies. Wire it into manual promotion workflows and app-release documentation; test missing URL and skipped-test detection.

L1.recipe: Mandatory environment wrapper for the focused Playwright staging suite with skip detection.

L2.recipe: Full ceremony orchestrator, JSON receipt, hermetic self-test, and workflow wiring.

L3.recipe: L2 plus signed receipt chaining to staging deploy and production promotion evidence.

executionLog.note: Shipped eight-step hash-chained ceremony and wired all four production-mutating workflows; live ceremony correctly rejects external identity/deploy blockers.

items.title: Forge freshness circuit — turn a 51-day journal gap into reviewed, source-bound publishing
items.why: PRE-VERIFIED: build:check reports the curated journal 51 days stale while the changelog and THE DESK feeds continue moving. Outcome: visitors and agents receive a current, editorially coherent studio narrative instead of only machine-like status feeds.
items.recipe: Reuse draft-weekly-forge.mjs and public intelligence/commit-map sources to generate one reviewable draft with explicit source citations, no private planning, and no launch promises. Add a freshness receipt distinguishing drafted/reviewed/published; publish only reviewed content and gate stale curated voice without auto-posting unreviewed copy.

L1.recipe: Generate and review one source-bound weekly Forge draft; publish manually in-repo.

L2.recipe: Draft/review/publish state machine, source hashes, freshness receipt, and content gate.

L3.recipe: L2 plus theme-specific cards, speakable schema, agent summary shard, and engagement attribution.

executionLog.note: Shipped source-bound draft→review→publish state machine; generated draft remains unpublished and honestly reports journal staleness.

items.title: Release dependency handshake — make cross-repo blockers executable, expiring contracts
items.why: NOVEL / PRE-VERIFIED: release-proof knows real-provider-e2e is pending, while the exact Ark request ID lives only in handoff prose and the inbox has no acknowledgement. Outcome: a founder or agent can see which owner was asked, what exact evidence is due, whether it was acknowledged, and when the request expired—without chasing Markdown or silently waiting forever.
items.recipe: Define a local public-safe release-dependency receipt keyed by cargo ID, owner slug, contract hash, requested checks, sent/ack/expires timestamps, and status. Derive it from signed Ark metadata only (no payload bodies), consume it in release-proof/status, and fail closed on expired or mismatched acknowledgements. Ship any Obelisk-side adoption request through Ark, not direct edits.

L1.recipe: Bind current cargo ID and contract hash into a local honest-dark receipt with expiry.

L2.recipe: Receipt builder, signature/ack matcher, release-proof integration, public status tile, and tests.

L3.recipe: L2 plus reusable multi-owner dependency DAG and automated retry/closure cargo generation.

executionLog.note: Shipped signature-verified, expiring Ark dependency receipt consumed by release proof; request is pending owner acknowledgement.

items.title: Agent intent map — outcome-first routing with evidence freshness
items.why: NOVEL / PRE-VERIFIED: AI discovery is structurally healthy, but agents.json primarily exposes resources/actions; it does not publish one compact mapping from visitor intent (play, join, verify, invest, press, build) to the best route, evidence source, freshness, and fallback. Outcome: agents and the command palette resolve an information goal in one lookup instead of crawling several pages.
items.recipe: Generate api/intent-map.json from sitemap, agents.json, site index, public intelligence, and status proof. Each bounded intent publishes primary/fallback URLs, audience, action capability, freshness state, evidence links, and abstention reason. Validate dead URLs, duplicate intents, internal leakage, and stale evidence; register the feed in agents.json and reuse it in the command palette without runtime AI cost.

L1.recipe: Six canonical intents with deterministic route/evidence mapping and schema test.

L2.recipe: Generator, freshness/abstention model, discovery registration, command-palette adapter, and gates.

L3.recipe: L2 plus intent composition, locale-ready aliases, and observed agent-query coverage scoring.

executionLog.note: Shipped seven outcome routes with evidence freshness, abstention, AI discovery, and command-palette integration; News remains preview-dark.

items.title: Staging browser gate contract — zero skips, exact tenant boundary
items.why: PRE-VERIFIED: the focused suite is the only test that reproduced the provider tenant-boundary rejection, yet it can report skipped when the URL is absent. Outcome: auth, themes, mobile navigation, and CSP are proven on the actual staging origin before any promotion decision.
items.recipe: Make the staging suite emit a machine-readable expected-test count and reject skipped tests in release mode. Add exact client/redirect assertions plus a foreign-callback negative control. Keep ordinary local Playwright use optional, but make the release entrypoint set and verify STAGING_RELEASE_URL explicitly.

L1.recipe: Release-mode no-skip assertion and expected-test count.

L2.recipe: L1 plus exact tenant controls, JSON summary, and release-workflow contract test.

L3.recipe: L2 plus cross-browser auth boundary and signed screenshot/trace manifest on failure.

executionLog.note: Shipped explicit-URL, zero-skip Chromium/Firefox/WebKit release gate; live result correctly rejects 3 provider journeys.

items.title: Engagement-window receipt — stop mixing fresh page views with month-old decisions
items.why: PRE-VERIFIED: analytics-summary observes Aug 4 traffic, while funnel-summary and Oracle feedback remain anchored to Jul 3 with no per-family freshness verdict. Outcome: product decisions clearly distinguish fresh exposure, stale interactions, and truly zero response instead of treating all zeros alike.
items.recipe: Extend the funnel rollup with observationStart/End, ingestedAt, ageHours, and per-family freshness/coverage. Update site-health and UX decision ledger to abstain on stale families; add a contract that fresh analytics cannot make stale engagement look current. Preserve aggregate-only privacy.

L1.recipe: Top-level data window and stale/honest-dark distinction.

L2.recipe: Per-family windows, downstream abstention, public receipt, and regression tests.

L3.recipe: L2 plus freshness-weighted decision confidence and expected-next-sample estimates.

executionLog.note: Shipped per-family observation windows and stale abstention; current 516-event window is 33 days stale and therefore non-decisive.

items.title: Deploy-currency quorum — no single challenged vantage owns production truth
items.why: PRE-VERIFIED: the apex and provider-owned Pages origins can both return challenge pages from automation, leaving a seven-day-old retained observation. Outcome: production freshness becomes independently verifiable without weakening challenge honesty or declaring a challenged probe current.
items.recipe: Add a provider metadata adapter through the existing Cloudflare capability plus routed apex and provider-origin HTTP probes. Require two agreeing evidence classes for current; disagreements stay unverified and name the conflicting source. Store only hashes/status/timestamps, redact account identifiers, and keep the single-vantage fallback honest-dark.

L1.recipe: Second HTTP vantage and explicit quorum/disagreement states.

L2.recipe: Provider API adapter via secrets gateway, 2-of-3 quorum, receipt provenance, and self-tests.

L3.recipe: L2 plus GitHub workflow deployment attestation and signed promotion lineage.

executionLog.note: Shipped four-vantage production quorum; routed+provider origin agree production is 802 commits / 12.2 days stale.

items.title: Decision-moment feedback sampler — ask one bounded question where uncertainty peaks
items.why: PRE-VERIFIED: generic micro-feedback exists and Oracle has zero helpful/unhelpful responses. Outcome: learn why visitors stop at join, proof, or play decisions without collecting raw text, identity, or interrupting every page.
items.recipe: Reuse the existing micro-feedback and bounded RUM allowlist to show one three-choice prompt only after a decision event (membership comparison exit, proof verification completion, Oracle answer, or game→Vault bridge). Sample/cooldown locally, publish aggregate theme confidence only after k-anonymity threshold, and connect accepted themes to the existing feedback provenance board.

L1.recipe: Oracle helpful/unhelpful prompt with cooldown and bounded telemetry.

L2.recipe: Four decision moments, sampling policy, thresholded rollup, provenance integration, and accessibility tests.

L3.recipe: L2 plus adaptive question selection from aggregate uncertainty, with a hard no-runtime-AI constraint.

executionLog.note: Shipped deterministic 1/3 post-decision sample, 7-day cooldown, local storage, and k≥5 aggregate publication promise.

items.title: Constellation resume compass — turn near-completion into the next meaningful page
items.why: NOVEL / PRE-VERIFIED: progress is high-water-marked locally and three constellations have unlocked, but two paths show step-one traffic with zero unlocks and the tracker exposes no resume affordance. Outcome: returning visitors see one atmospheric, privacy-local next step instead of restarting or abandoning a discovery path.
items.recipe: Derive the nearest incomplete constellation from local progress and current route, then render a dismissible compass that names the next destination and why it matters. Never show on first page or after completion; preserve keyboard/reduced-motion behavior. Emit bounded shown/followed/dismissed events and validate no identity/server storage.

L1.recipe: One returning-visitor resume link for the nearest incomplete path.

L2.recipe: All constellations, route-aware copy, cooldown, telemetry, tests, and seven-theme rendered proof.

L3.recipe: L2 plus constellation map preview and proof-linked completion ceremony.

executionLog.note: Shipped nearest-incomplete local path compass with dismiss/follow telemetry and no first-visit/current/completed misrouting.

items.title: Rotate the 177KB task board and enforce a startup token floor
items.why: PRE-VERIFIED: the build gate warns that TASK_BOARD.md is 177KB with nine rotatable blocks beyond the three-session window. Outcome: every future start/audit reads less stale history while preserving append-only provenance in the archive.
items.recipe: Run the existing rotate-taskboard.mjs, validate task IDs and closeout boundary, then add a size/rotatable-block check to the startup preflight with an explicit repair command. Measure brief+task tokens before/after and record the savings in the skill-cost ledger.

L1.recipe: Rotate now, verify archive and task IDs, record byte/token delta.

L2.recipe: L1 plus startup warning/repair contract and self-test.

L3.recipe: L2 plus automatic safe rotation during closeout when the boundary ledger is green.

executionLog.note: Shipped lossless task-board rotation and 42k startup floor; rotated nine old blocks and saved an estimated 7,874 startup tokens.
